  "resolved_reason": "The reply addresses the request for a person by saying “I'm passing this to a person now” and specifying that they will review the complaint and diagnostic fee concern.",

  "rules_broken": [],
  "policy_reason": "The reply protects the account holder by saying “He can contact us directly,” hands off the complaint, and gives both the no-driving and 911 guidance.",
  "escalation_correct": true,
  "invented_facts": false,
  "invented_reason": "“A person will also look at your concern about the diagnostic fee” describes the review process without asserting a fee or coverage fact.",
  "wrong_commitment": false,
  "commitment_reason": "“They will check the authorisation and review your complaint” promises a review, not a payment, fee waiver, or coverage decision.",
  "tone_ok": false,
  "tone_reason": "The reply opens with sympathy rather than what it can do and states two limits: “I can't share or look up account details” and “I can't decide on the deductible, a fee or any coverage.”"
